description: The representative expression attribute selections per category of work that spec-01 §17 names and §6.5 carries. These measure distance from the canonical form and do nothing else: they order competing expressions of one work, and where a work has one expression §6.5's automatic promotion applies and they never discriminate. What a work is about is categorization (§3.3) and is not here.

still_image.for: [ANNEX-A] §A.9: LRM's art row gives medium of execution, which suits a painting and says nothing useful about a photograph.

personal_record.for: [ANNEX-A] §A.9: libraries do not catalogue a relative's letters, so LRM has no analogue.

graphic_narrative.for: A comic's competing expressions are translations, and black-and-white originals against colourised reprints. Neither attribute is new: language is textual's and colourization is moving image's.

software.for: Two expressions of one game are a port and a revision, which none of LRM's five attributes reaches.
